notes.text: New or low-trust accounts can see a SUBMIT CTA on the homepage, but clicking it may do nothing. Homepage may also show the warning: Since you are new, you can unlock special abilities by contributing to discussions. Treat this as a posting restriction gate.

Before planning a launch post on Indie Hackers, first verify the account has enough community trust or points. If SUBMIT is non-responsive, do not keep retrying; switch to community participation first.

workflows.name: Indie Hackers posting readiness check
workflows.description: Check whether the current Indie Hackers account can create posts before preparing copy.
steps: Open homepage and look for the new-account special abilities warning.
Click the homepage SUBMIT CTA once.
If the page does not navigate or open a composer, treat the account as restricted and stop the posting task.
Earn trust first by leaving useful comments and interactions before retrying a launch post.
